claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photos show the drum exterior and cap only; interior emptiness/residue cannot be confirmed remotely.
No food-grade certification mark, resin code, or manufacturer label visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No usage history, receipt, or prior-content label visible; cannot be confirmed from images.
Only the front/visible side of the drum is shown; base, rear, and seams are not visible in either photo.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show the red screw cap lid seated on the drum with no visible damage.

risks.risk: Drum may have held industrial or chemical contents rather than food/water, affecting safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any manufacturer/content label, UN hazard code, or resin/food-grade stamp on the drum body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-food-grade/industrial-use drum (lower tier).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, dents, or leaks on the base or unseen rear side.
risks.proof: Additional photos of the base, rear, and a water-fill or tilt leak-test video.

risks.risk: Cap/lid may not seal airtight despite looking 'complete'.
risks.proof: Short video of the cap being twisted off and back on, showing threads and gasket intact.

risks.risk: Actual liquid capacity unclear ('210' code and '10.2KG' weight don't confirm liter volume).
risks.proof: Photo of a liter-capacity marking or a measured fill-level reference.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the smallest plausible capacity consistent with a standard drum size.

risks.risk: Interior residue or odor from prior contents not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Photo/video looking into the open drum interior.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unclean/residue-present until shown otherwise.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full drum base and rear side
Close-up of any content/food-grade/resin label or hazard code on the body
Short video of the cap being removed and reseated to show seal condition
Video or photo looking inside the open drum
Photo showing a liter-capacity marking if present
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a used plastic screw-lid drum, so it can be priced at worst case given unverifiable food-grade, prior-content, and leak/seal claims.
